prompt:

Scene: Adult designer sketches and models elegant lamp.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "formge → formgivare: design → designer.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Han är formgivare och skapar lampor.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
STYLE reference only. Essential scene correction: the designer is an adult MAN with short hair and beard, working on lamps. He matches the Swedish example Han. Reproduce all teaching text exactly. Square, cream and gold heading, navy type, gold caption, blue example strip.
